subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or wait for another current-main fix path before closing this issue?
rationale: The issue has an open same-author candidate PR with closing references, but that branch is conflicting and proof-gated while current main already contains partial recovery behavior.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can keep the recovery intent while using current active-run/session lifecycle helpers and live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original contributor can update the existing PR against current main and add redacted live tab-switch/reconnect evidence before another review.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: If another PR becomes the viable fix path, close the stale linked PR and then close this issue when the replacement is merged and proven.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can keep the recovery intent while using current active-run/session lifecycle helpers and live Dashboard proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent current-main history on the refactored Dashboard chat and Gateway session active-run paths involved in the remaining repair choice.
